description: I have excellent problem-solving, communication and leadership skills, coupled with adaptability, resilience and patience, honed through nearly two decades of policing.

Beyond dealing with members of the public in almost every scenario imaginable, bringing order to the chaos of emergency incidents, I have designed, implemented and delivered national training courses and worked collaboratively with large organisations such as the UK Home Office, Airbus UK and Motorolla. I can confidently communicate with clients and stakeholders and all levels.
You can read more about my policing experience, although I am now seeking professional opportunities in software development, having dedicated myself to structured education in this area.
